task: Fix icon event handler memory leak

issue.description: Event listeners accumulate on every renderDesktop() call
issue.impact: Unbounded memory growth - 40 orphaned listeners per re-render with 10 icons
issue.root_cause: grid.innerHTML = '' destroys DOM but listeners remain in memory

fix.description: Use AbortController signal to automatically cleanup listeners on re-render

changes.description: Added AbortController creation and cleanup at start of renderDesktop()
Added { signal } to all 4 icon event listeners (mousedown, mousemove, mouseup, mouseleave)
Added { signal } to global mousemove handler
Updated cleanup() method to use abortController.abort()

test_steps: Verify listener count remains constant (not growing)
memory_profiling: Compare - should NOT show linear growth in listeners

blockers_encountered.issue: File locked by running Python process (iHIM server with auto-reload)
blockers_encountered.resolution: Created Python script to apply fix programmatically, then fixed syntax error manually

handoff_notes: @qa-tester: Please verify drag-and-drop still works correctly after fix. Check browser console for errors. Run memory profiler to confirm leak is resolved.

what_went_well: Identified leak immediately - grid.innerHTML destroys DOM but not listeners
Used modern AbortController pattern (cleaner than manual removeEventListener)
Created Python script to handle file locking issue
Caught and fixed syntax error (misplaced parentheses)
what_could_improve: Could have extracted JavaScript to separate file for easier syntax checking
Could have added automated test to detect listener accumulation
learnings: AbortController is the modern standard for cleanup - scales better than tracking individual handlers
Watch for file locking when Python server has auto-reload enabled
Always verify syntax after regex-based replacements
